name: @w6w-apps/agencyzoom
description: Manage leads, customers, policies, tasks and pipelines in AgencyZoom, the insurance agency management CRM.

w6w.longDescription:
AgencyZoom is a CRM built specifically for insurance agencies: leads move through sales pipelines, sold leads become customers, customers hold policies, and tasks (calls, emails, meetings, to-dos) drive the day-to-day follow-up.

This app covers that core loop — search and create leads, move a lead through its pipeline stage or mark it sold, look up and create customers and their policies, and manage tasks — plus the reference lookups (pipelines and stages, lead sources, carriers, employees, CSRs) a workflow needs to fill in the IDs those writes require.

Every path, verb and field here was verified against AgencyZoom's own published OpenAPI 3.0 document (`app.agencyzoom.com/openapi/agencyzoom.yaml`) plus live probes against `api.agencyzoom.com`. AgencyZoom authenticates like a human user logging into the product — a username and password exchanged once for a JWT — rather than an API key, so see `auth/login.ts` for what that means for a workflow connection.
